title: access.yaml: who can deploy as a team, where, and under which gates

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace on the team's clusters. Defaults to the team (folder) name.

group.description: IdP group that gets read-only kubectl on the team's namespaces

owners.description: GitLab users/groups who approve changes to this folder (CODEOWNERS)

projects.description: GitLab project path globs allowed to deploy as this team, e.g. acme/payments/*

stages.description: Stages the team deploys to, with extra gates

protectedRefOnly.description: Jobs must run on a protected branch or tag

requireProtectedEnvironment.description: The GitLab environment must be protected (approvals, allowed deployers)

domains.description: Host globs apps may claim with ingress.hosts

webhookEnv.description: Env var on DAAS holding the team's chat webhook URL
